2124226472554492045.en_summary: Nvidia $NVDA: Token prices have fallen nearly 60% since May, accelerating token usage and demand for compute. ticker_notes.NVDA: token prices down 60%, GPU rental prices rising, Hopper up to 2x, B300 +60%
